title: Quality Dense Polish Wagyu Pilaf
description: A rich and flavorful Polish dish featuring Wagyu beef, cure, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: Wagyu beef
ingredients.notes: cured in salt and black pepper

instructions: Heat the ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the cured Wagyu beef and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Basmati rice and stir to combine with the beef and mushroom mixture.
Add 4 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
